decisions.reason: The mitred family builds on the firm's core metalworking and handle expertise, so it can interpret and improve its modest early results.
Its move to a dedicated page and multifunctional focus signal successful assimilation and alignment with electronic/accessibility trends.
As a generic door-handle line with no distinct early results or differentiation from established ranges, it is unlikely to benefit enough from further learning and is culled.
Award wins and sustained own-page presence validate its design and market fit, so the firm keeps this high-performing collection.
